dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast perimeters transitioning from a black exterior to a mottled light-gray interior along the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated within the interior regions of the macro-annuli and scattered along the upper dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent macro-annuli centroids in the central dorsal area form an elongated, obtuse-angled triangle following the curvature of the spine.

other_distinctive_markers: Several prominent, near-vertical, light-yellow linear foreground occlusions (likely dry vegetation) cross the body at regular intervals.
